description: Aerial drone drift over an empty plot of land with survey stakes
Time-lapse construction: two villas rise floor by floor, perimeter wall and driveway appear, orbit camera
Finished villas: lawns and trees grow in, pool fills, loungers and umbrella appear, lower orbit
People walking by the pool, driveway and gardens, street-level camera
Gate slides open, car drives in and parks at the main entrance, tracking camera
Camera flies through the opening front doors into the furnished interior toward the pool view
Title, captions, transitions between the six cuts and the Agentoon.ai outro (+ Follow Agentoon.ai)
